subject.title: message tool should auto-select the only enabled account

question: Should omitted message-tool account IDs infer the single enabled/configured account after channel selection, or should OpenClaw continue requiring explicit account selection when the default account is disabled?
rationale: The requested fallback changes documented default-account behavior for existing multi-account setups, so maintainer intent is needed before the linked PR lands.

options.title: Accept shared resolver policy
options.body: Review and land a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound account IDs first, then picks an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account, with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

options.title: Keep explicit account selection
options.body: Close or narrow the linked PR and document that users must set accountId or defaultAccount when the default account is disabled.

options.title: Require channel-owned fallback
options.body: Ask for a WhatsApp-only or plugin-owned adjustment if maintainers do not want core to own this fallback policy across channels.

recommendation.title: Accept shared resolver policy
recommendation.body: Review and land a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound account IDs first, then picks an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account, with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the prior review direction for this issue and is the strongest routing candidate for the fallback policy decision.
